## Problem and resulting behavior

What would a shop operator notice? Include a short before/after example.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify anything not tested.
For UI changes, include desktop/mobile evidence using non-customer examples.
For nesting/output changes, describe quantity, physical-scale and cut checks.

## Limits or follow-up

State known limitations. Physical printing/cutting and signed installation tests
must not be implied by unit tests or successful folder delivery.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Contributor PR targets `cursor/shop-open-handoff-9891` unless the owner changed the target.
- [ ] No customer artwork, source paths, local databases, credentials or generated packs.
- [ ] No production installation changes, release/version bump, or bypassed safety checks.
- [ ] Draft status retained while checks or operator review are incomplete.
